name: U-Pack Professional White Crepe Paper Masking Tape (72mm / 3-Inch x 50m)
shortDescription: Extra-wide 72mm premium saturated crepe paper masking tape with clean-removal natural rubber adhesive for sharp paint lines and zero glue residue.
overview: U-Pack Professional Masking Tape is an extra-wide 72mm (3-inch) premium saturated crepe paper tape designed for automotive spray booths, industrial powder coating preparation, and high-end architectural painting. Coated with a specially cross-linked natural rubber adhesive, it adheres smoothly to metal, glass, plastic, wood, and rubber gaskets, forming razor-sharp paint separation lines without bleed-through. When peeled, it lifts cleanly in one piece without tearing or leaving sticky adhesive residue, even after bake cycles up to 80°C.
keyFeatures: Extra-wide 72mm (3-inch) width provides large overspray protection margin with single pass
Saturated crepe paper backing provides excellent flexibility around curves and contours
Natural rubber adhesive delivers instant tack with guaranteed clean peel removal
Leaves razor-sharp paint edges with zero bleed-under of solvent or waterborne paints
Temperature resistance up to 80°C for 30 minutes in paint baking booths
Tears easily by hand in straight lines without requiring scissors or cutters
Resists moisture, solvents, and paint bleed-through during heavy spray application

specifications.Clean Removal Window: Up to 7 Days Indoors without Residue

applications: Automotive body shop spray painting, panel masking, and pinstriping
Industrial machinery painting, two-tone color line masking
Architectural interior painting around skirting boards, switches, and glass panes
Temporary surface holding, light bundling, and labelling in workshops
